 Judgment
The appellants are the owners of land Survey No.11/2 of Harkanchi village, Taluk & District Kalaburagi measuring 04 acre 02 guntas of dry land.
The lands were acquired for construction of Bennithora Project vide Notification dated 11th April 1985.
The Special Land Acquisition Officer awarded compensation of Rs.3,500/- per acre of dry land vide award dated: 25th February 1989.
The Reference Court enhanced the compensation amount to Rs.14,000/- per acre for dry land.
In appeal, the District Court computed the compensation at Rs.27,000/- per acre for dry land.

Hence,
the appellants are before this Court seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. Learned counsel for the appellants submits that the co-ordinate bench of this Court in MSA No.200119/2017 vide order dated 19.02.2018, has enhanced the compensation of Rs.1,20,814/- for dry land with all statutory benefits, which were acquired under the same notification, same village and for the same purpose.
Further he submits the appeal in MSA NO.200119/2017 is taken up to the Hon'ble Supreme Court in NC: 2024:KHC-K:2221 Civil Appeal No.7343/2021, which came to be dismissed.
Hence on the ground of parity, he seeks enhancement.

3. Per contra, learned HCGP does not dispute the said fact and submit that the land in question are acquired for the same notification, same village and for the same purpose in respect of lands in Sy.No.11/2 of Harkanchi village, Tq & Dist:
Kalaburagi is disbursed.

4. For the aforesaid reasons and discussions, the matter has attained finality and prayer of the appellants seeking enhancement of the compensation, shall be treated on par with the compensation awarded by Lower Appellate Court in respect of land losers of different survey number of the same village which were acquired for the same project vide notification dated 11th April 1985.
5. In that view of the matter, the appellants in this appeal are also entitled to the compensation of Rs.1,20,814/- per acre of dry land and the same is awarded.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
NC: 2024:KHC-K:2221 ORDER a) The appeal is allowed in part with costs.
